findings.element: Events tab, Held row 'Plate seconds (B-grade)' after using 'Match it'
findings.finding: After the user matches the item via 'Match it', nothing tells them the held change still has to be retried: the row still reads 'Held · Item not matched · Match it', the overview still shows Held 1, and the Mappings view only says 'Every product is matched.'
findings.user_impact: Users believe the fix is done and leave, so the +12 stock change stays held and Shopify stays wrong (KF-2 'thought it was done' drop-off).
findings.suggested_fix: Once the item is matched, change the row reason to 'Matched — ready to retry' with an inline Retry, and make the mapping toast offer 'Retry 1 held change'.

evidence.action: State 2 → Held '1' link → 'Match it' → pick 'Plate seconds (B-grade) · PL-SEC' → Back to overview → Events tab
evidence.observed: Toast 'QuickBooks item mapped.'; Mappings shows 'Every product is matched.'; overview still Held 1; Events row unchanged 'Held · Item not matched · Match it' until 'Retry held and failed' is clicked (toast '1 held change sent.').

findings.element: Store card status badge 'Ready' and the setup banner, while Sync is Disabled
findings.finding: Once location and setting are fixed, the store badge turns 'Ready' and the 'needs setup' banner disappears, but sync is still Disabled; the only remaining step (Enable) sits in another column with no pointer from the store card.
findings.user_impact: 'Ready' plus no banner reads as 'done', so users can leave with sync off and no stock changes ever sent.
findings.suggested_fix: While sync is Disabled, show a 'Ready to sync — turn on sync' banner with an Enable button, and label the store badge 'Ready · sync off'.

evidence.action: State 1 → connect My ceramic plates → Choose location → Save → Open Settings
evidence.observed: Banner gone; store badge 'Ready'; Sync block (middle column, 651,360) shows 'State: Disabled … Enable'; store card text is only the rows and 'Connect store'.

findings.element: 'Connect store' button at the bottom of the Shopify stores card
findings.finding: 'Connect store' is a filled primary button in every state; during setup it is the only filled button while the three required fixes are small outlined buttons, and once ready it is styled identically to Enable.
findings.user_impact: Visual weight steers users to add another store instead of finishing the current one or turning sync on, splitting attention at the drop-off-prone steps.
findings.suggested_fix: Make 'Connect store' a secondary (outlined) button once a store exists, so the current fix action — and later Enable — is the only filled primary.

evidence.action: Computed styles of main-area buttons after connecting My ceramic plates and again after the store became Ready
evidence.observed: Setup: Connect store bg rgb(0,83,204) filled; Choose location / Open Settings / Match products white outlined btn-sm; Enable grey cursor not-allowed. Ready: Enable and Connect store both filled rgb(0,83,204).

findings.element: Stock check block count vs Reconcile table (State 2)
findings.finding: The Stock check block says '2 … 2 products in My ceramic plates differ', but the Reconcile page it links to lists 3 unresolved differences, including Rose bouquet (+2) in My good flowers.
findings.user_impact: The summary and the list it opens disagree, so users can't tell whether they've handled every difference and may miss stores the summary omits.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the block count every unresolved row that Reconcile shows, broken down by store (e.g. '3 products differ: 2 in My ceramic plates, 1 in My good flowers').

evidence.action: State 2 → Stock check count link → Reconcile tab
evidence.observed: Block: 'Stock differences 2 — 2 products in My ceramic plates differ'. Table: Unresolved rows Ceramic plate 24cm +8, Mug set +2, and My good flowers · Rose bouquet +2.

gaps: Run now: only toasts, so manual-sync feedback and its effect on Activity counts are unknown
Failed events: no Failed sample data, so the Failed state and its recovery path were never reached
Shopify install redirect: simulated by an in-page loader, so a return-from-Shopify failure or cancel state is unknown
Accept QuickBooks while sync is Disabled/Paused: whether the created sync event is queued, held, or sent and how the UI communicates it is not recorded
Banner 'Show': only scrolled ~47px with no visible highlight; whether it reliably brings the target store's first fix into view on longer pages (2+ stores) was not verified
